meta.description: Arabic and English CV screening for small and medium companies in Egypt.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.body: The link may have changed or the page was removed. Nothing in your account was deleted.

usage.label: CVs this month
usage.remaining: {left, plural, =0 {No CVs left this month.} one {{left} CV left this month.} other {{left} CVs left this month.}} Processing continues.
usage.paused: Processing is paused. {waiting, plural, =0 {No files are waiting} one {{waiting} file is waiting and will be processed} other {{waiting} files are waiting and will be processed}} when you upgrade or on {date}. Nothing was deleted or hidden.

score.title: Score breakdown
score.excluded: Not used in scoring: name, gender, age, photo, nationality and marital status.

evidence.searchedFor: We searched the CV for: {terms}. None of them appear.
evidence.notFound: This quote wasn't found in the document. Treat the claim as unconfirmed.

upload.drop: Drag up to {max} files here, or choose files
upload.formats: PDF, DOCX, DOC, JPG or PNG. You can leave the page while they process.
upload.dropNow: {count, plural, one {Drop {count} file to upload it} other {Drop {count} files to upload them}}
upload.limitReached: Processing is paused: you've reached this month's limit of {limit} CVs
upload.limitDetail: Everything you uploaded is still here. The limit renews on {date}.
upload.unsupported: Unsupported language ({language}). The file is kept and not scored.
upload.summary: {total, plural, one {{total} file} other {{total} files}} · {parsed} parsed · {review} need review · {failed} failed · {unsupported} unsupported language · {working} in progress
upload.tooMany: {extra, plural, one {{extra} file wasn't added} other {{extra} files weren't added}}: you can upload up to {max} at a time.

reject.title: Reject {name}?
reject.body: You'll be recorded as the person who decided. The candidate stays in the list as “Rejected”, with their score and reasons, and you can undo this later.
reject.notify: Send the candidate a rejection notice after {days, plural, one {{days} day} other {{days} days}}

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lede: Screen and rank CVs, with a written reason for every candidate.
signIn.inviteOnly: Access is by invitation for now. If you haven't been invited, ask your company's account owner.

errors.missing: Enter your work email and your password.
errors.invalid: That email and password don't match. Check both and try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in isn't available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.google: Google sign-in didn't finish. Try again, or sign in with your email and password.

noAccess.title: This account has no access yet
noAccess.notInvited: This Google account hasn't been invited to any organisation on Masirah. No account was created and nothing was stored.
noAccess.noOrganisation: This account isn't part of any organisation on Masirah, so there is nothing to open yet.
noAccess.askOwner: If your company uses Masirah, ask the account owner to invite your work email.
noAccess.useInvited: Or sign in with the work account the invitation was sent to.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.caption: Your jobs, most recently active first

empty.title: No jobs yet
empty.body: Every ranking starts with a job. Create one, add CVs to it, and each candidate is ranked with a written reason.
empty.stepCreate: Create a job: title, required skills and minimum experience.
empty.stepDrop: Drop CVs onto the job, up to {max} files at a time.
empty.stepReview: Review the ranking: each candidate has a written reason quoting their CV.

attention.noCvs: Drop files onto the job to start ranking
attention.processing: {processing} processing · {decisions, plural, one {{decisions} needs a decision} other {{decisions} need a decision}}
attention.decisions: {decisions, plural, one {{decisions} needs a decision} other {{decisions} need a decision}}

gallery.title: Design system
gallery.intro: The shared components every screen is built from, in their states. Hover, focus and press appear when you interact with them.
gallery.statesNote: States shown: default, disabled, loading and error.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.note: One primary button per screen. The destructive button is never filled, and a trailing ellipsis means a confirmation follows.

fields.title: Fields and selects
fields.note: Native controls, 36 px high. An error replaces the helper text, so the field keeps its height.
fields.jobTitleHelp: Candidates see it on their application status page.
fields.jobTitleLocked: The title can't change once the job is published.
fields.jobTitleChecking: Checking for a job with the same name…
fields.jobTitleMissing: A job title is needed to save the job.
fields.languageHelp: Used only for the Language part of the score.
fields.locationHelp: Suggested from the job description. Change it or save it as it is.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.note: The selected tab is marked by weight and an ink underline, not by amber.
tabs.label: Job sections

status.title: Status, confidence and decisions
status.note: Every indicator is a shape and a word, with color as a third, extra channel. A decision always names who made it.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.note: Focus opens on the safe choice, Escape closes it, and focus returns to the button that opened it.
dialog.heading: Discard your changes to this job?
dialog.body: The job goes back to its last saved version. Candidates and their scores are not affected.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.note: They state a fact and offer one action.
toasts.batchDone: 24 of 25 files are processed. One needs review.
toasts.rejected: Mohamed Abdallah was rejected. The decision is recorded in your name.
toasts.sendFailed: 3 messages couldn't be sent. Nothing was sent twice.

switcher.title: Language switch
switcher.note: Names the other language in its own script, and keeps the same page when switching.

score.title: Score
score.note: A numeral and a neutral bar, never a color grade. The breakdown comes after the reasons, not before.
score.unavailableReason: The CV couldn't be read, so it wasn't scored. Open the original or upload a clearer copy.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.note: Each claim is numbered and leads to the CV line it relied on, or is marked as an absence. Quotes keep their own language and direction.
evidence.heading: Why ranked third
evidence.claim1: Worked four years on React apps at Vodafone Egypt
evidence.claim2: Led a team of three developers
evidence.claim3: The CV mentions no automated testing
evidence.quote1: Front-end Engineer, Vodafone Egypt (2020 to 2024). Built and maintained React dashboards for the Ana Vodafone app.
evidence.quote2: Led a squad of 3 front-end developers; ran code reviews and sprint planning.

candidates.title: Candidate list
candidates.note: 36 px rows with the reason in the widest column. Documents that aren't ranked stay visible below the ranking.
candidates.reason1: Six years of React at Instabug; led the design-system migration
candidates.reason2: Strong TypeScript; short tenures, three roles in four years
candidates.reason3: Four years at Vodafone Egypt building React apps
candidates.reason4: Scanned CV; employment dates partly unreadable
candidates.reason5: The CV shows no front-end experience
candidates.blurred: the image is blurred. Upload a clearer one.

upload.title: Upload
upload.note: One row per file, the reason in plain words, and one action that fixes it. An unsupported language is kept and listed, never dropped.
upload.tilted: the photo is skewed and the dates are uncertain

usage.title: Usage meter
usage.note: A tick at 80%, where the words change. At 100% it explains the pause and how many files wait. The bar goes from grey to ink, never red.

reject.title: Reject confirmation
reject.note: Focus opens on “Keep candidate”, and the reject button stays disabled until a reason is chosen. This is the only filled red.
